title: Spectacular!  Don't miss seeing these sites in person!
text:
When we arrived for the tour, the guides told us that Park Guell was not part of the tour.  I reached out to Viator real time via chat and they insisted it was part of the tour.  It was not.  In any event, it was very windy the day of our tour so Park Guell was likely closed anyway for this reason.

We did, however, tour Casa Batlló extensively, see Casa Milà from the outside and tour La Sagrada Familia extensively.  Alberto with WalksDevour was our tour guide and he was excellent!  He was very pleasant, kept a comfortable pace while keeping us on time -- even with a subway ride!  And he share
author: Keita_R

title: Excellent experience with Alicia
text: Our tour guide Alicia was fantastic. She was deeply knowledgeable about Casa Batlló, Park Güell, and La Sagrada Família, and gave engaging, useful background on each site and the Gaudí-influenced places we visited in Barcelona. She spoke at a perfect pace so the whole group could follow, patiently answered every question, and made personal connections with everyone. Highly recommended and will bring my family back next time!
author: Heather_H

title: Valentine was wonderful.
text: We truly appreciated Valentine's thorough knowledge of both Casa Batllo and Sagrada Familia.  She shared many things that would have been easy to overlook in Casa Batllo and highlighted amazing aspects of the Sagrada Familia!
author: Journey12726687077

title: We loved this tour
text: We were a group of 4 women in our 60's. Alicia was our FABULOUS guide. Casa Batlló was our favorite part of the tour, but we also enjoyed the park and the church. Alicia took great care of our group and shared tons of interesting info.
author: Stephanie_E

title: A MUST Tour When In Barcelona
text: The tour was spectacular! Our guide was spectacular! The Gaudi experience was spectacular! Honestly, Gaudi was an exceptional architect, artist, and visionary in my opinion and this tour brought this exceptionalism to everyone on the tour through our guides passion and knowledge. I would sign up again in a heartbeat.
author: vincemD2196NS

title: Amazing Architecture!
text: It was a perfect introduction to Gaudi. The guide took us to all the best spots to take pictures, had strong knowledge of detailed imagery on the walls of the Sagrada Familia and of architectural elements inside, and she was attentive to the needs of the group. There was one gentleman with us who had a hard time doing the steps to the top of Casa Battlo and down to Park Guell, so if you are older or have trouble with steps, you may want to consider this.
